[SWS_DM_01571] Load persisted data
⌈
On a DM startup trigger from Exe-
cution Management, DM shall restore all data, which was persisted from persistent
memory.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01571] Recovery of persisted data
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall recover all relevant persisted data (e.g.
data persisted during shutdown such as defined Dynamical Data Identifiers or Event
and DTC status). The earliest point in time to recover this data is the startup of the
Diagnostic Server instance. The latest point in time to recover this, is when
the data is actually needed (lazy loading)
⌋
